title: Five months on, exhaustion signals are building on the primary front — and being overridden rather than acted on
dek: Since 28 February 2026, the United States and Israel have been at war with Iran and the network of state and non-state actors aligned with it. This memo updates our 5 August assessment with the intervening two weeks of reporting.

title: The water number everyone quotes is real — and structurally misleading
dek: A sense-making analysis of Australia's AI buildout: Systems Thinking, Cynefin, and Wardley Mapping applied to the water footprint of the AI infrastructure boom — consumption, discharge, and the governance gap between them.
